bio.text: Tamara Trujillo is the Constitution Party candidate for Wyoming Secretary of State in 2026.
Trujillo's WyoFile election guide response says the candidate grew up and lives in Cheyenne and graduated from Cheyenne Central High School.
The response says Trujillo began a career with the State of Wyoming's Child Support Division and later served as a Naval Air Station ombudsman while married to a military spouse.
The response also says Trujillo worked for 17 years in accounting and procurement at the refinery in Cheyenne.
